snippet.title: Wild Arms (PSX Trailer)
snippet.description: Wild Arms. A game that I wished I've played more but I was too eager in waiting for FF7 back then. Too bad it's hard to find a copy now...and I don't like to download either. It just doesn't have the same feeling as owning the original.
